findings.current: Of course, the undead’s pursuit had soon ground to a halt when their magical power ran out, yielding nothing.
findings.defect: “Their” attributes the depleted magical power to the undead rather than leaving it with the Skeleton King who controls them.
findings.rationale: The passage links depleted magical power to the end of the Skeleton King’s undead pursuit; it does not say the undead exhausted their own power.
findings.replacement: Of course, the Skeleton King had soon run low on magical power, and the undead’s pursuit had ended without yielding anything.
findings.source: 물론 금세 바닥을 드러낸 마력과 함께 언데드들의 추적도 아무런 소득 없이 멈췄지만

findings.current:
“Come on, Jin-sama! You can’t do this!”

“I can. Here I am.”
findings.defect: Yamamoto’s rhetorical “where” and Jin’s literal “here” no longer form the source’s deadpan exchange.
findings.rationale: Jin answers the implied question of where such a thing happens, rather than asserting that he can do it.
findings.replacement:
“Jin-sama! Where does that even happen?”

“Right here.”
findings.source:
“아니, 진 사마! 그런 게 어디 있습니까!”

“여기 있어.”

findings.current: Little room to move. Few ways to escape.
findings.defect: The draft changes a narrow escape route into a small number of escape routes.
findings.rationale: Both the available space and the escape route are described as narrow, which matters to Jin’s assessment of the canyon.
findings.replacement: Little room to move. A narrow escape route.

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but it changes who runs out of magical power, loses a deadpan exchange, and alters a terrain detail.
